question: What is the total number of households in Arecibo county?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:country) WHERE t2.county = 'ARECIBO' RETURN sum(t1.households)

question: Please list the numbers of males in all the residential areas in Arecibo county.
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:country) WHERE t2.county = 'ARECIBO' RETURN sum(t1.male_population)

question: Among all the residential areas in Delaware, how many of them implement daylight saving?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:country) WHERE (t2.county = 'DELAWARE' AND t1.daylight_savings = 'Yes') RETURN count(t1.zip_code)

question: Please list the Asian populations of all the residential areas with the bad alias "URB San Joaquin".
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:avoid) WHERE t2.bad_alias = 'URB San Joaquin' RETURN sum(t1.asian_population)

question: Among the residential areas with the bad alias "Internal Revenue Service", how many of them are in the Eastern time zone?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:avoid) WHERE (t2.bad_alias = 'Internal Revenue Service' AND t1.time_zone = 'Eastern') RETURN count(t1.zip_code)

question: Please list the bad alias of all the residential areas with a median female age of over 32.
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:avoid) WHERE t1.female_median_age > 32 RETURN DISTINCT t2.bad_alias

question: What is the alias of the city called Hartford?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:alias) WHERE t1.city = 'Hartford' RETURN DISTINCT t2.alias

question: How many counties are there in Alabama?
gql: MATCH (t1:state)<-[state:STATE]-(t2:country) WHERE t1.name = 'Alabama' RETURN count(t2.county)

question: How many post offices are there in New York?
gql: MATCH (t1:state)<-[state:STATE]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE (t1.abbreviation = 'NY' AND t2.type = 'Post Office') RETURN count(DISTINCT t2.zip_code)

question: In the state where Lisa Murkowski is the representative, how many cities have zero employees?
gql: MATCH (t1:congress)<-[t2:state]-(t3:zip_data) WHERE (t1.first_name = 'Murkowski' AND t1.last_name = 'Lisa' AND t3.employees = 0) RETURN count(t3.city)

question: How many males are there in New Haven County's residential areas?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:country) WHERE t2.county = 'NEW HAVEN' RETURN sum(t1.male_population)

question: Show the alias for the county at coordinate (18.090875, -66.867756).
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:alias) WHERE (t1.latitude = 18.090875 AND t1.longitude = -66.867756) RETURN t2.alias

question: For the city with the most elders, what's its area code?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:area_code) RETURN t2.area_code ORDER BY t1.over_65 DESC LIMIT 1

question: For the county represented by Thompson Bennie G, how many bad aliases does it have?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_congress)<-[t2:avoid]-(t3:congress) WHERE (t3.first_name = 'Thompson' AND t3.last_name = 'Bennie G') RETURN count(DISTINCT t2.bad_alias)

question: How many counties are there in Virginia State?
gql: MATCH (t1:state)<-[state:STATE]-(t2:country) WHERE t1.name = 'Virginia' RETURN count(t2.county)

question: What is the longitude and latitude for the district represented by Grayson Alan?
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[t2:zip_congress]-(t3:congress) WHERE (t3.first_name = 'Grayson' AND t3.last_name = 'Alan') RETURN t1.latitude, t1.longitude

question: List all representatives of districts which have more than 30 000 population in 2020.
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[t2:zip_congress]-(t3:congress) WHERE t1.population_2020 > 30000 RETURN t3.first_name, t3.last_name

question: How many zip codes are under Barre, VT?
gql: MATCH (t1:CBSA)<-[cbsa:CBSA]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE t1.CBSA_name = 'Barre, VT' RETURN count(t2.zip_code)

question: Calculate the difference between the 2020 population and the 2010 population for the districts represented by Griffin Tim.
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[t2:zip_congress]-(t3:congress) WHERE (t3.first_name = 'Griffin' AND t3.last_name = 'Tim') RETURN (t1.population_2020 - t1.population_2010)

question: Give the name of the country and state of the city with elevation of 1039.
gql: MATCH (t1:state)<-[t2:country]-(t3:zip_data) WHERE t3.elevation = 1039 RETURN DISTINCT t1.name, t2.state

question: What is the Asian population in the city with the alias Leeds?
gql: MATCH (t1:alias)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE t1.alias = 'Leeds' RETURN sum(t2.asian_population)

question: Among the cities with area code 608, how many cities implement daylight savings?
gql: MATCH (t1:area_code)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE (t1.area_code = 608 AND t2.daylight_savings = 'Yes') RETURN count(t2.city)

question: Provide the average elevation of the cities with alias Amherst.
gql: MATCH (t1:alias)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE t1.alias = 'Amherst' RETURN avg(t2.elevation)

question: What is the country and state of the city named Dalton?
gql: MATCH (t1:state)<-[t2:country]-(t3:zip_data) WHERE t3.city = 'Dalton' RETURN t2.county

question: What is the difference in the number of cities with P.O. box only and cities with Post Office among the cities with area code 787?
gql: MATCH (t1:area_code)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE t1.area_code = 787 RETURN (count(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'P.O. Box Only' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) - count(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'Post Office' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)) AS DIFFERENCE

question: Among the postal points in the District of Columbia, how many of them have an area with above 20000 black population?
gql: MATCH (t1:country)<-[zip_code:ZIP_CODE]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE (t1.county = 'DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA' AND t2.black_population > 20000) RETURN count(t1.zip_code)

question: Provide the zip code, city, and congress representative's full names of the area which has highest population in 2020.
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[t2:zip_congress]-(t3:congress) RETURN t1.zip_code, t1.city, t3.first_name, t3.last_name ORDER BY t1.population_2020 DESC LIMIT 1

question: Among the daylight savings areas in the Midwest region, how many postal points are there in Illinois?
gql: MATCH (t1:state)<-[state:STATE]-(t2:zip_data) WHERE (t1.name = 'Illinois' AND t2.daylight_savings = 'Yes' AND t2.region = 'Midwest') RETURN count(t2.zip_code)

question: Compare the numbers of postal points under Smith Adrian and Heck Joe.
gql: MATCH (t1:congress)<-[district:DISTRICT]-(t2:zip_congress) RETURN CASE WHEN count(CASE WHEN (t1.first_name = 'Smith' AND t1.last_name = 'Adrian') THEN t2.zip_code ELSE NULL END) > count(CASE WHEN (t1.first_name = 'Heck' AND t1.last_name = 'Joe') THEN t2.zip_code ELSE NULL END) THEN 'Smith Adrian>Heck Joe' ELSE 'Smith Adrian<=Heck Joe' END AS COMPARE

question: Provide the zip codes and the congress representatives' names of the postal points which are affiliated with Readers Digest.
gql: MATCH (t1:zip_data)<-[t2:zip_congress]-(t3:congress) WHERE t1.organization = 'Readers Digest' RETURN t1.zip_code, t3.first_name, t3.last_name
